newsitem.title: USA: American Healthchoice in stock offer.
newsitem.headline: American Healthchoice in stock offer.

text.p: American HealthChoice Inc said on Monday that it plans a public offering of the company's common shares.

It said that it has agreed with underwriters Sands Brothers & Co that, dependent upon market conditions and certain other factors, this public offering could generate gross proceeds greater than $20 million for the company.

"With the infusion of this substantial capital we look forward to continuing our mission of building American HealthChoice into a significant, vertically integrated matrix of health care clinics throughout the southeastern tier of the United States," company president J.W. Stucki said in a statement.
